title: Have you seen this dream location?
content: Last night I was invited to a party in my dream that began on a roller coaster. We went through a decrepit home with pink walls and many rooms on the roller coaster, sometimes weaving out a window and back in. The people operating it played light pranks like spraying water on you when you went by. I can’t remember if it was single story or had multiple, but the roller coaster wasn’t going up very often, just forward and through, like a kid ride. It wasn’t scary. The location felt very familiar. After, we had a banquet in one room of the house where tables lined the walls and some long tables were in the middle, potluck style with lots of strange food I didn’t recognize available. It was casual, and almost everyone I knew was there but seated. The space looked like a mix of these images. No stairs and the walls were peeling a bit, the floor was bare like in the third image. These are the closest images I could find but neither are quite it.
